evidence_basis: McCrimmon et al. 2025, Cell Reports (PMID 40925365, PMC12674601): the whole text (.txt, 608 lines, summary, introduction, results, discussion, limitations, STAR Methods; the reference list was not read) read from the PMC open-data bucket copy after a committed pre-registration (commit eb12d4ce5) that stated what had been seen. Figures 5, 6 and 7 and Fig S2 and S3 viewed as images; the legends of Figs 1 to 7 from the xml and of Figs S1 to S7 from the supplement PDF read; Figs 1 to 4, 8, S1 and S4 to S7, Tables S2 to S5 and the six videos not opened.
